title: Even-wise frequency family
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, with $k$ even. There is a family $\mathcal F$ of subsets of an $n$-element set such that $|S\cup T|\le k$ for every $S,T\in\mathcal F$, and $|\mathcal F|=\sum_{j=0}^{k/2}\binom{n}{j}$.
